args.body:
Migration is complete: all 10 batches (400 records) are in the new CRM.

Problem you should know about before sales relies on the phone numbers:

The old CRM stored numbers without country codes. The new CRM assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. Validation on batch 3 said 31 of the first 120 records (batches 1–3) belong to overseas customers, so those numbers are wrong, and batches 4–10 have the same problem. I do not have a count or the specific customer IDs for batches 4–10, and I do not have the correct numbers, so I did not edit any phones.

14 sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours, so some of them may already be using the bad numbers.

Next step: I can correct the overseas numbers once you give me the list of customer IDs and the right phone numbers (or point me at a source for them). Until then, treat phone numbers on migrated overseas accounts as unreliable.
